configuration_rule: Record requested/admission/effective under approved Plan A; no trusted echo => UNVERIFIED, no quota or backend probes. Explicit unsupported/downgrade must be reported. No CLI/native substitution.
dispatch_owner: Parent coordinator; author does not spawn or approve own review
candidate_commit_binding: author-draft-1/publication-receipt-after-sync.json in report-only successor; review the newly frozen full nine-path candidate, never the earlier six-path draft

roles.scope: Every complete qualified local control: 16 contributions, 10 primary; originals and final bodies/catalogs, full unfiltered predecessor-to-candidate diff, static legal positive/negative designs and preserved accepted clauses/owner rows
roles.independence: Must be independent of A-B15; author evidence is input, not verdict

roles.required: Exact independent dispositions for nine frozen potential interfaces; additional bounded PASS_SCOPED gates only where actual semantic impact or the approved contract requires them
roles.scope: B02/B03/B04/B06/B07/B08/B09/B10/B14 exact clause/caller/data/condition and qualified accepted receipt. B03/B04/B08/B14 are author-prioritized navigation, not independent impact verdicts. No automatic whole-owner reapproval.
roles.independence: No author-issued PASS or NOT_AFFECTED; every disposition binds the exact new candidate

roles.scope: At future exact actual SHA inspect full accepted-predecessor-to-actual and candidate-to-actual diffs, including original scope/application, public registration and dependencies. Same final bytes do not transfer candidate approval.
roles.independence: Separately dispatched exact actual gate; cannot be replaced by author checks or candidate receipt

roles.role: Necessary independent bounded affected actual reviewers
roles.required: Every affected gate or exact independently supported NOT_AFFECTED required by the frozen contract and candidate impact assessment
roles.scope: Exact future actual version and bounded accepted-owner interfaces; no candidate-to-actual transfer and no automatic whole-batch reapproval

review_write_boundary_note: These are proposed reviewer-only evidence directories for parent to freeze in separate dispatches. Author has not written them and does not grant reviewer permission to mutate formal specifications or public shared files.
public_writer: A-REG only; serial public integration and registration
finite_author_end: Exact approved three-original patch applied and all before/proposed_after identities matched; complete bounded author package, new full candidate SHA and unfiltered diff published by ordinary push; independent remote ref/FETCH_HEAD/tree and all changed bytes read back. Author turn ends with independent review and actual acceptance still pending.
review_finite_end: Reviewer returns exact SHA-bound complete local-control decisions and required bounded interface dispositions with source/premise/design/regression evidence, writes only its parent-approved directory, and reports all REQUEST_CHANGES or unresolved limits; no author self-review or canonical/global closure claim.
